first_error_evidence: Step 5: 'ERROR: Cannot execute multiple commands at once' when agent included a leading comment line before the oh-my-zsh install command; this repeated pattern affected ~9 commands throughout the trajectory.
near_miss_description: The 'z' plugin was cloned to the wrong path '/plugins/z' (step 12) because $ZSH_CUSTOM was unset in the non-zsh shell context, rather than the correct '~/.oh-my-zsh/custom/plugins/z'. This could have caused the z plugin to fail loading. Additionally, bash verification commands (steps 28-45) repeatedly used non-interactive 'bash -c' invocations that triggered .bashrc's early return guard, causing repeated spurious failures that led the agent to make redundant and partially conflicting edits to .bashrc.
near_miss_evidence: Step 12 output: 'Cloning into '/plugins/z'...' (incorrect path). Steps 28, 29, 35, 41, 45 all showed 'bash: line 1: conda: command not found' due to non-interactive shell guard, yet the underlying .bashrc configuration was actually correct.
verification_evidence: Step 27: 'zsh -c "source ~/.zshrc && conda info"' confirmed active environment is terminal-bench. Step 47: 'bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate terminal-bench && python --version"' returned 'Python 3.10.19'. Step 48: 'zsh -c "source ~/.zshrc && python --version"' returned 'Python 3.10.19'.
one_sentence_strategy_summary: The agent systematically installed zsh, oh-my-zsh, plugins, miniconda, and a terminal-bench conda environment, but repeatedly wasted steps due to a persistent comment-as-command formatting error and failed to correctly diagnose why bash verification commands kept failing (non-interactive .bashrc guard), leading to unnecessary redundant edits.
